dedupe_keys.name: transset north carolina highway drone vehicle image benchmark

description: TRANSSET is a drone-captured image dataset from two North Carolina highway locations on Interstates 40 and 440. The Data in Brief article reports 4,704 high-resolution frames selected from 4K footage acquired at about 140–200 feet under varied conditions. Figshare version 5 lists a public ZIP and README under CC BY 4.0; its description reports 21,661 annotated vehicles with eight classes and machine-learning labels. The raw drone videos are withheld under North Carolina Department of Transportation ownership and privacy rules. This is a detection benchmark from two sites, not a continuous measured traffic-flow time series or a national vehicle mix. Camera angle, chosen frames and withheld video are limitations for reconstructing complete trips or validating flow rates. A reviewer-assessed use is testing vehicle counting before using counts in a road simulation. model-sumo is a related traffic simulator, but no image-to-network calibration was performed. No image archive was downloaded.
